source_refs.section: On iPhone 17e, iPhone 16e, iPhone 15, and earlier models without a Home button

source_refs.title: Change volume, sound, & vibrate settings - Android Help
source_refs.applicability: Android 12 and later; the page says some of these steps work only on Android 12 and up
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Press a volume button. At the right, tap the Menu icon (labeled More). Slide Ring Volume to your preferred level.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android 12 and later: Press a volume button. At the right, tap the Menu icon (labeled 'More'). Slide 'Ring Volume' to your preferred level.

source_refs.title: Change volume, sound, & vibrate settings - Android Help
source_refs.applicability: Android; the page describes it in the same volume panel
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Press a volume button, then tap Ring above the slider. Tap Vibrate or Mute. To restore sound, turn off Vibrate or turn on Ring.
